movers.text: QB Carson Beck (back) is out at Kansas City; 40-year-old Josh Johnson starts, with rookie Joey Aguilar as backup. Gardner Minshew is on IR.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is inactive; Kirk Cousins starts Sunday night against San Francisco in Mexico City.
OL: OT Taliese Fuaga, C Erik McCoy and OT Asim Richards are inactive at Chicago. Three line starters missing.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is inactive vs. Tennessee; Brian Schottenheimer said he would likely miss multiple weeks. S P.J. Locke III (concussion) is also inactive.
Secondary: CBs D.J. Reed (hip, third straight game) and Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder) are inactive vs. Tampa Bay. DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) is out for the season; C Cade Mays is on IR.

ARI.text: QB Carson Beck (back) is out at Kansas City; 40-year-old Josh Johnson starts, with rookie Joey Aguilar as backup. Gardner Minshew is on IR.
G Jon Gaines II (ankle) is out a fourth straight game; C Hjalte Froholdt is cleared from concussion protocol and starts.

TB.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot/right thumb), listed questionable, is active and starts at Detroit. S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) and CB Josh Hayes (knee) are inactive.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is inactive; Kirk Cousins starts Sunday night against San Francisco in Mexico City.
WR Jordan Addison (thumb surgery) and CB Isaiah Rodgers (quadriceps) are inactive vs. San Francisco.
TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist) has no injury designation and LB Blake Cashman (concussion) is cleared; both are back vs. San Francisco.

NO.text: OL: OT Taliese Fuaga, C Erik McCoy and OT Asim Richards are inactive at Chicago. Three line starters missing.
Defense: LB Pete Werner and CB Martin Emerson Jr. are inactive at Chicago, and starting S Justin Reid was released at his request.

KC.text: OL: G Trey Smith and OT Jaylon Moore are inactive vs. Arizona, as are RB Kenneth Walker III and DTs Peter Woods and Omarr Norman-Lott.

NYJ.text: QB Geno Smith (ankle) has no injury designation and starts at the Chargers. WR Omar Cooper (ankle) is out; G Dylan Parham (knee) is questionable.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) could return Week 16, per ESPN's Dan Graziano. Jacoby Brissett starts at Carolina.
CB Marlon Humphrey (team decision), S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) and DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) are inactive at Carolina.

DET.text: Secondary: CBs D.J. Reed (hip, third straight game) and Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder) are inactive vs. Tampa Bay. DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) is out for the season; C Cade Mays is on IR.
S Kerby Joseph is active vs. Tampa Bay for the first time this season.

DAL.text: CB DaRon Bland (ankle) went on IR Saturday, S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) was downgraded to out, and G Tyler Booker (high-ankle sprain) is out vs. Tennessee.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is inactive vs. Tennessee; Brian Schottenheimer said he would likely miss multiple weeks. S P.J. Locke III (concussion) is also inactive.

BUF.text: TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is inactive vs. Miami, along with CB Christian Benford (groin) and LB Dorian Williams (calf).

CHI.text: CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) is inactive vs. New Orleans; the injury could also keep him out of the Thanksgiving game at Detroit.

SF.text: WR Mike Evans (Achilles), out since leaving Week 6 early, is active vs. Minnesota; LB Dre Greenlaw (neck) is inactive.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord remains the starter at Buffalo.
S Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder/groin) is inactive at Buffalo; C Aaron Brewer cleared concussion protocol and plays.

PHI.text: Joe Milton starts vs. the Steelers for a second straight game; Tanner McKee is the backup. Jalen Hurts is on IR.
LB Zack Baun (back) and WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) were placed on IR Saturday.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), out five of six games, practiced fully and will play vs. the Steelers.

CIN.text: G Dalton Risner (knees) is ruled out for Monday at Washington; G Dylan Fairchild (oblique) is questionable. QB Joe Burrow (illness) has no designation.
S Kyle Dugger (quadriceps), out six games, is questionable for Monday at Washington.

WAS.text: CB Amik Robertson (ankle, hurt in Friday practice) is questionable for Monday vs. Cincinnati; C Lucas Patrick cleared concussion protocol and will start, per Dan Quinn.

JAX.text: C Robert Hainsey (knee) is out for Sunday at the Giants, per Liam Coen.

LV.text: TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is inactive at Denver after limited practices Thursday and Friday.

PIT.text: LB Nick Herbig is inactive at Philadelphia; LB Patrick Queen (broken thumb) and S DeShon Elliott (knee), both questionable, are active. G Mason McCormick is on IR.

TEN.text: WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), out two games, is active at Dallas.
WR Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) is on IR and out for the season, per Robert Saleh.

DEN.text: S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle), out four games, has no designation vs. Las Vegas; CB Kris Abrams-Draine is back. S Brandon Jones (hamstring) is questionable.

LAC.text: LB Daiyan Henley (knee) and CB Tarheeb Still (ankle) are inactive vs. the Jets; WR Ladd McConkey is active.

IND.text: The Colts released QB Daniel Jones; Shane Steichen named Anthony Richardson the starter going forward, with Riley Leonard as backup.
